sections.name: 01-dia-transition-banner
sections.text: Meet Dia, the next evolution of Arc Weekly security updates, SOC 2 certification, and the Arc DNA you know (and love). Try Dia
sections.assessment: 迁移横幅：把续作宣传嵌入首屏，用产品图形和胶囊 CTA 承接升级叙事。

sections.name: 02-arc-editorial-hero
sections.text: Arc is the Chrome replacement I've been waiting for. FYI: Arc receives Chromium updates only. For active security patches and enterprise-grade protection, download Dia instead. Download Arc for Mac Download Arc for Windows MORE DETAILS
sections.assessment: 媒体引语 H1 与双平台下载构成品牌宣言，大字宽幅置入钴蓝底。

sections.name: 03-browser-story-video
sections.text: A browser that doesn’t just meet your needs — it anticipates them. Clean and calm, Arc shapes itself to how you use the internet.
sections.assessment: 大标题右置、全宽视频下沉，形成左文右动态画面的非对称分栏。

sections.name: 04-spaces-product-video
sections.text: Space for the different sides of you. Effortlessly organize everything you do online — work, study, hobbies — all in one window with Spaces and Profiles.
sections.assessment: 以真实操作视频解释 Spaces/Profiles，延续纵向交错的产品叙事。

sections.name: 05-footer-cta
sections.text: Enter your new home on the internet Download Arc for Mac
sections.assessment: 钴蓝底上的 28px CTA 形成动作终点，白色下载按钮与奶油文字延续品牌色收束。
